description.value: The study validated a modified Empathic Accuracy Task using naturalistic autobiographical emotional videos, continuous ratings of perceived emotional intensity, and a neutral control condition to investigate neural correlates of emotional processing, empathic accuracy, and affect sharing.

design.value: A within-subjects fMRI study in which 34 healthy participants watched and continuously rated six autobiographical video clips, comprising two happy, two sad, and two neutral clips. A separate normative sample of 60 healthy participants completed the task outside the scanner.

description.value: Assessment of current or recurrent episodes of mental illness.
A self-report questionnaire measuring dispositional empathy using fantasy, empathic concern, perspective taking, and personal distress subscales.

name.value: Wechsler Abbreviated Scale of Intelligence, Second Edition (WASI-II)

source_definition.value: Pearson's correlation coefficient between the participant's ratings and the target's ratings for each video clip, r-to-Z transformed.

role.value: parametric modulator and term of interest

association_direction.value: positive and negative modulation were tested

name.value: participants' ratings of the target's emotional intensity

source_definition.value: Continuous ratings of the target's emotional intensity for each 2 s bin.
Button presses were included as a condition of no interest to control for task-related hand movement artefacts.
Seven movement parameters, comprising six standard parameters and volume-to-volume movement, with additional regressors for volume-to-volume movement exceeding 1 mm.

description.value: Healthy participants aged between 20 and 30 years, fluent in English and with no history of neurological illness.

exclusion_criteria.value: current or recurrent episodes of mental illness
excessive head movement or poor task performance (<2 SD in empathic accuracy scores)

description.value: Healthy participants who completed the EAT outside the MRI scanner.

inclusion_criteria.value: The same inclusion criteria as described above were applied.

exclusion_criteria.value: current or recurrent episodes of mental illness

task_description.value: Participants watched six video clips of people talking about autobiographical events while continuously rating the narrator's emotional intensity. The clips comprised one happy, one sad and one neutral video featuring one female and one male target, with additional clips used for pre-training and volume adjustment.

instructions.value: Participants were instructed to continuously rate the perceived emotional intensity of the target using a 9-point scale from 1, 'no emotion' to 9, 'very strong emotion'. Following each clip, they reported which emotion the target felt most strongly and which emotion they themselves felt most strongly.

stimuli.value: Autobiographical emotional video clips depicting targets describing happy, sad, or neutral events. Neutral targets described their bedroom.

task_performance_measures.value: Empathic Accuracy score, computed by correlating participants' ratings with targets' ratings for each video clip.

task_description.value: Participants completed the EAT outside the MRI scanner by watching and rating 27 video clips in randomised presentation order.

instructions.value: Participants continuously rated the perceived emotional intensity of the target using the same 9-point scale.

stimuli.value: 27 expressive video clips: 7 happy, 7 sad, 3 angry, 3 frightened and 7 neutral clips, with additional clips for pre-training.

instrument.value: General Electric MR750 3.0 T MR scanner with a 12-channel head coil

description.value: T2*-weighted gradient echo, echo-planar imaging sequence covering 41 axial slices and recording 347 volumes sequentially, descending.

instrument.value: General Electric MR750 3.0 T MR scanner with a 12-channel head coil

description.value: T1-weighted Magnetization Prepared Rapid Gradient Echo MPRAGE image acquired to facilitate fMRI data registration and normalisation.

pulse_sequence_type.value: Magnetization Prepared Rapid Gradient Echo MPRAGE

description.value: EPI files were reoriented, slice-time corrected, realigned, coregistered to the T1-weighted image, normalised to MNI space using group-wise DARTEL registration, resampled to 1.5 mm isotropic voxels, spatially smoothed with an 8 mm Gaussian FWHM kernel, and supplemented with extraction of a CSF time course.

steps.value: slice-time correction with the middle slice as reference
realignment to the first image and subsequently to the time series mean
coregistration of the mean EPI image to the T1-weighted image
group-wise DARTEL registration to create a common group-specific template
normalisation of functional EPI files to MNI space
spatial smoothing with a Gaussian FWHM kernel of 8 mm
extraction of the time course signal of a CSF mask defined as the top 5% from the DARTEL CSF component

model_settings.value: Block design with separate regressors for happy, sad, and neutral video presentation, formed by convolution of the canonical HRF with boxcars delimiting video presentation. Seven movement parameters, CSF signal, button presses, additional regressors for volume-to-volume movement exceeding 1 mm, and a 209 s high-pass filter were used.
Group-level paired t-tests and one-sample t-tests were used. Statistical nonparametric permutation inference was performed with randomise.

estimator.value: statistical nonparametric permutation inference with randomise
